turns.q: Tell me about the White Paper project
turns.answer:
This is one I'm proud of — a long-standing client of over a decade, the UK's leading provider of legal and business CPD conferences. I designed and built their booking engine and on-demand platform, replacing a painful eight-step checkout and a mess of disconnected systems with something far leaner.[[casestudies]]

The results spoke for themselves: drop-off fell by around 90%, processing time by 85%, and the on-demand side now brings in a solid chunk of their revenue. Their back office went from four people handling bookings down to one.

turns.q: Tell me about the White Paper project
turns.answer:
White Paper's a long-standing client — a UK provider of CPD conferences for legal and business professionals, going back over 20 years. I designed and built their on-demand platform and booking engine, which meant untangling a booking flow that took eight interactions to get from programme to checkout, and pulling their conference data out of a handful of disconnected platforms into one place.[[casestudies:white-paper-booking-engine-design-development]]

The results were the satisfying part: drop-off fell by around 90%, and back-office processing time dropped enough that they went from four people handling bookings to one.
